spans.s: † पुल् पुल्, i. 1, and 6, and 10, Par. To be great or large, to be lofty or high.

† पूल् पूल्, i. 1, Par. To accumulate.
 --i. 10 (or पूण् पूण्, or पुण् पुण्), Par. To accumulate.

पुल,
 I. adj. Extensive.
 II. m. Erection of the hairs of the body, considered as proof of exquisite delight.

पुल + क, m.
 1. Erection of the hairs of the body, considered as occasioned by pleasure, Vikr. d. 57.
 2. Flaw or defect in a gem.
 3. A ball of bread and sweetmeats with which elephants are fed.
 4. An insect of any class affecting animals whether externally or internally.
 5. A kind of esculent plant,

.
 --Comp.

पुलाक, m. and n.
 1. Shrivelled, or blighted, or empty grain.
 2. Bad grain,

. A lump of boiled rice.
 4.

Abridgement.
 5
. Celerity.
पुलकय, a denomin. derived from पुलक with अय, Par. To have or feel one's hairs of the body erect by pleasure,

.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. पुलकित, rather पुलक + इत, [] adj. Having the hairs of the body erect,
पुलस्त्य, i. e. पुरस् + त्य, m. The name of one of the seven Ṛṣis and mental sons of Brahman,
पुलह, m. The name of one of the seven Ṛṣis and mental sons of Brahman,

पुलिन, m. and n.
 1. An alluvial formation, a small island,
. The bank of a river, Pañc. 226, 19.

पुलिन्द, m.
 1. pl. The name of a barbarian tribe.
 2. One belonging to this tribe, Pañc. 120, 8.
 3. A prince of the Pulindas,

पुलिन्द + क, m.
 1. The name of a people.
 2. A proper name.

पुलोम,
 I. m. = पुलोमन्,

.
 II. f. मा, The wife of Kaśyapa (Viṣṇu
पुलोमजा, i. e. पुलोमन्-ज. f. Śacī, the wife of Indra.
पुलोमन्, m. The name of an Asura (ŚKD.), or Dānava (
